name: connect-ai-writer
description: Your AI writing employee. Give it something you made (a video, its subtitles, your notes or your own page) and it writes a post for every text platform in your own voice, with pictures made from your real material: Threads, Naver blog, X, LinkedIn, Instagram and more. It checks every number against your source, shows a preview, and can put the draft in the editor through Ego Lite, stopping before the post button.
author: CONNECT AI LAB
